exposure: number of previous cesarean sections (2 or more)
type of cesarean section (emergency vs. elective)
cohort: The study included 42 patients with a history of cesarean section, scheduled for hysteroscopy at a hospital in Bogotá, Colombia.
finding: The prevalence of isthmocele was 83.3% in patients with a history of cesarean section, with higher rates observed in those with dysmenorrhea, multiple cesareans, and emergency cesarean sections.
mod_finding: A higher prevalence of isthmocele was observed in patients with a history of 2 or more cesareans and an emergency cesarean section.
